Nexus · Quoting platform

Design rounds — complete bundle

Six rounds of design work, each rendered as a self-contained HTML file. Open any file directly — no server, no fetches, no missing assets. Every state of every surface is reachable via the in-page state strip and Tweaks panel.

Rounds
R1

Initial concept exploration

First-pass design concepts across the full quoting flow — Project, Quote setup, Cost input, Costing workspace. The starting point that R2+ refined.

project · quote setup · cost input · costing workspace · designer notes

R2

Cost Build & Costing Sheet

Two-surface flow: Cost Build (PM input) → Costing Sheet (margin verdict + per-cell sell). Empty / partial / tunable stages.

3 build stages · 3 costing scenarios · cost-stack waterfall · margin verdict pill
→
R2.5

Multi-tier mechanics

Apply-to-all (60% case) vs. supplier-quote-sheet (40% volume-break case). Sparkline tier-spread vocabulary.

apply-to-all · per-tier sheet · mark-as-flat · null discipline
→
R3

Customer view + Mark accepted

PDF-preview metaphor for the customer-facing artifact, plus the internal Mark-Accepted workflow (locked / both-gates / pending).

3 customer states · 3 mark-accepted states · tier-table vs single-tier PDF
→
R4

Workspace shell + deal organizer + project detail

Two-tier rail (cross-project outer + per-project inner), HubSpot-anchored deal organizer, multi-scenario project detail, Copy Scenario / Copy Quote flows.

3 organizer states · 3 project detail states · copy-within / copy-across
→
R5

Admin surfaces

Firm policy (target/floor with effective-dated history), markup defaults (per-category), audit log (filterable, expandable diff).

firm settings · markup defaults · audit log · 3 states each
→
R6

Cost Build redesign — single page, four peer sections

Replaces the legacy four-tab IA. Cost stack on top, then Packaging · Production · Bulk Raw · Freight as peer drilldowns. Conditional RAW row driven by raws-mode. Deposit chips, dual-yield reconcile.

3 states · 4 sections · 3 raws-modes · per-line treatments

About these bundles. Each round HTML is fully inlined — CSS, JSX, fonts, data fixtures all live inside the file. You can open them straight from disk, drop them into a tar/zip, mail them around, or serve them statically. No build step, no network calls. To walk every state of a round: open the file, use the state strip across the top of the page, and toggle the Tweaks panel (bottom-right) for finer controls.
